title: The Atlassian AI SDLC Index
summary: How is AI changing software development? The Atlassian AI SDLC Index tracks real data from 500+ engineering orgs on code, reviews, quality, and spend.

## Methodology


[DX](https://getdx.com/) is an engineering intelligence platform designed to help engineering organizations measure and improve software health, developer productivity, and AI-human collaboration for a truly AI-first SDLC.


The dataset represents a sample of more than 340,000 engineers at 500+ engineering organizations that use the DX platform. Companies range in size from fewer than 50 to over 10,000 employees, represent a wide geographic spread from Europe to Asia to North America, and encompass many industries, including finance, retail/e-commerce, and healthcare. All self-reported and telemetry data are aggregated at the company level, which means that team-level variation within organizations is not captured.
